Mumbai Rains Cause Disruption, One Fatality Reported

Mumbai experienced heavy rainfall leading to severe waterlogging and disruption across the city. The downpour caused flooded streets, submerged vehicles, and inundated markets. Tragically, a 17-year-old student died due to electrocution amidst the adverse weather conditions.
